profile.a: The author, writing individually for Corporate Governance and Ethics.
Meta's board and the stakeholders who can hold it to account: shareholders, employees, users and regulators.
Meta's governance and ethics when executive bonuses rose while staff were laid off, and when generative AI raised new risks on privacy, bias and misinformation.
Handed in on 3 March 2025, after early-2025 layoffs and bonus approvals, a similar 2023 restructuring, and content moderation changes from January 2025.
Meta Platforms globally: Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.
Pay and jobs moved in opposite directions, and founder control through dual-class shares limits the board's ability to correct that.
Reviews board structure and ownership, pay, employee relations and stakeholder engagement, applies three ethical frameworks to AI, and proposes eight governance controls and three reforms.
